title: Unexpected input does not crash the gate open
why: Claude Code documents that a hook which exits with any code other than 0 or 2, times out or prints invalid output does not block: the tool runs anyway, unless the hook sets onFailure "block". The case sends an unusual but valid request (a 200 KB id and an unexpected nested field) with no approval.

sources.title: Claude Code hooks reference: exit codes and failure behaviour
